name: Delilah
overview: The story of Delilah, as recorded in Judges 16, reveals her role as Samson's lover who was enticed by the Philistine leaders to discover the secret of his great strength. She persistently questioned Samson about the source of his power, seeking to bind him and deliver him into their hands. Despite Samson's attempts to mislead her with false means of binding, Delilah's actions ultimately led to the revelation of his true weakness, demonstrating the dangers of misplaced trust and the consequences of compromising one's God-given strength.
